summary: Mustard Made is a female-founded colourful locker and homewares brand with offices in Newcastle (Australia) and London. Head of Finance Luke Avron-Cotton, who started in Sep 2025, leads finance across Australia, the UK, Europe and the US and was hiring a Management Accountant in Sep 2026. The finance function runs two legal entities, multiple currencies, ecommerce and wholesale, with inventory in several regions.

hooks.text: Luke's Sep 2026 Management Accountant post and job ad: the team is being built out and month-end across two entities is the core workload.
